description: This Java source file defines the class 'PolicyQueryCommandResponseAdapter', which acts as an adapter for mapping 'PolicyQueryCommandResponse' objects to and from 'Adaptable' representations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It includes a factory method to instantiate the adapter with a specific header translator, and overrides a method to specify the response criterion as a string.
